messages:
cleo: Heads-up: CI linkcheck flagged a bunch of broken anchors after the recent markdown lint merge. Looks related to fenced codeblocks with language hints containing parens, e.g. ```python(3.9)```. rahul: Weird, how do codeblock language tags affect anchors? cleo: Example: source header `### Install` produced id `install` normally, but when preceded by a fenced block with lang `python(3.9)` the generated slug engine created `install-1` and the sidebar still links to `#install`. Repro in /examples/sdk/python-auth. doc-ci: [linkcheck] ⚠ 6 anchor mismatches detected. Sample: /examples/sdk/python-auth#getting-started -> 404 (generated id: getting-started_1). Job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/16012 zoe: I think the parser treats the `(3.9)` as part of the header context when generating collision keys. We recently switched to a unified slugifier that concatenates nearby tokens (code fence meta included) for uniqueness. rahul: Can you paste the small HTML excerpt? cleo: Sure: `
...

Getting Started

` build-bot: [build] Error: anchor mismatch in /examples/sdk/python-auth (6 failures). zoe: Quick mitigation: strip parentheses & version qualifiers from language classes during slug generation, and normalize header slug generation to ignore adjacent codeblock meta. I'll open a PR to the mdx slug plugin. rahul: For immediate unblock, can we post-process generated HTML to rename `getting-started_1` -> `getting-started` only when the latter is referenced by incoming nav links? Keep it minimal. cleo: I wrote a tiny python post-build script that maps suffixed ids back if the hyphenated slug is present in sidebar links. Added to CI for the deploy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/802 doc-ci: [ci] Job 16020 started for PR 802 zoe: Works as a bandaid but we should also sanitize codeblock classes at source so future language tags like `python-3.10` or `bash+profile` don't cause similar issues. I'll add tests for various lang tokens. rahul: Also spotted a separate but related bug: the Python SDK snippet in that example imports `from redwood import RedwoodClient` but our SDK changed to `from redwood.client import RedwoodClient`. Linkcheck flagged the snippet because the example link points to the wrong API path. I added a second commit to PR 802 fixing the snippet. cleo: Nice catch. I added a CHANGELOG entry and ticket DOCS-447 to track the slugifier refactor and codeblock-class normalization. build-bot: [ci] Job 16020: staging linkcheck passed after post-build patch and snippet fix. ✅ cleo: Merging the bandaid so the release isn't blocked. Follow-ups: DOCS-447 (slugifier), DOCS-448 (codeblock lang policy), DOCS-449 (SDK snippet linter). Closing thread. :lock_with_ink_pen:
